resources.string: Show carrier name on the lock screen
Restore the SIM carrier text in the lock-screen status bar. Changes take effect after restarting System UI.
Enable glass materials for the notification shade, control center tiles, and sliders. Changes take effect after restarting System UI.
Add AM/PM to the status bar clock. Changes take effect after restarting System UI.
Place AM/PM before the time instead of after.
Replace the in-display fingerprint icon with Meizu style. Changes take effect after restarting System UI.
